data.description:
## Incident Overview

`test_dispatch_count_cap_triggers_escalation` and `test_wall_clock_cap_triggers_escalation` in tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh verify the caps fire (escalation message, non-zero exit) but do not assert that LLM dispatches were actually attempted before the cap was hit. A regression where dispatch is silently skipped would still pass these tests.

## Source

CI llm-review iteration 8 finding [7] on PR #37 (job 74100719710). Classified IMPORTANT by reviewer; analysis classified MINOR (asserting on internal counter is implementation-coupling; the unit-under-test is the cap behavior).

## Suggested Fix

Add an assertion on a behavioral signal — e.g., `grep -c 'DISPATCH:' $logfile` matches expected dispatch count — without coupling to internal variables.
data.title: thread-resolution caps tests: don't assert LLM dispatch attempts -> caps fire but dispatch behavior untested
